subject.title: fix: inbound messages can be reprocessed after gateway restart or reconnect (persistent replay dedupe + bounded durable replay)

question: Should OpenClaw make the durable inbound receive replay/fail helper a public Plugin SDK channel-outbound contract and use a five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter cap as the default delivery policy?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible best fix, but public Plugin SDK expansion and a message-suppression policy after repeated failures are maintainer-owned product/API decisions.

options.title: Accept API and cap
options.body: Keep the public channel-outbound durable replay exports and five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter behavior after the branch is refreshed against main.

options.title: Keep helper internal
options.body: Narrow the SDK exports/docs/baseline changes while preserving the channel bug fixes through internal seams.

options.title: Change replay policy
options.body: Choose a different cap or operator-controlled policy before merging the WhatsApp dead-letter path.

recommendation.title: Accept API and cap
recommendation.body: Keep the public channel-outbound durable replay exports and five-attempt WhatsApp dead-letter behavior after the branch is refreshed against main.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main owner for these files and merger for adjacent recovery work, making him the best visible routing candidate for the API/policy decision.
